event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: IDs of the DATA-class log events to re-produce onto their originating Kafka topic (1-500 items).

payloads.title: Payloads
payloads.description: Edited message bodies, keyed by event_id, for messages the operator changed before resubmitting. Any id left out is resubmitted exactly as archived. The edit applies to this resubmission only - the stored record is never rewritten - and is refused for a payload the caller may only see masked.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project of the node to deliver to.

workflow_id.title: Workflow Id
workflow_id.description: Workflow of the node to deliver to.

via_node_id.title: Via Node Id
via_node_id.description: Upstream node whose output topic carries the message. Every other node downstream of it receives the message too. Required when the target has more than one upstream node.

target.description: Send every message to this node instead of back onto the topic it was archived from. Left out, each message returns to its original queue.
